firstLines.value: Tooling: added isolated baseline runner/tests and usage documentation; fixed Windows namespaced paths, source alias/private-file handling, spawn-error capture and failed-check exit status. Hardened tooling tests pass 10/10, captured exit 0. First full baseline had runner-contaminated Bun/build results and three genuine TypeScript diagnostics; one retry was interrupted while copying. Final detached-run evidence is tracked in the current report. Application behavior, UI, tokens, schema, dependency manifests and lockfiles were not edited in this continuation.
